summary: Join our Public Finance Management Training Course to master key concepts in budgeting, financial analysis, and accountability for better public sector outcomes
lede: Public finance management links budget planning, expenditure controls, reporting, and oversight to the services public resources support. For professionals who prepare budgets, manage public spending, or review financial reports, the course offers practical ways to develop budget proposals and cash plans, track expenditure against allocations, and identify control gaps and fiscal risks.
audienceIntro: This Public Finance Management Training course is designed for professionals who plan budgets, control public expenditure, prepare fiscal reports, or review compliance across the budget cycle.
modules: Digital Reporting and Public Finance Action Plan
prerequisites: You should have a basic working knowledge of public-sector finance, budgeting, or accounting. Familiarity with financial reports, spreadsheets, and internal control concepts will help you get the most from the exercises, but no programming is required. If you already work with budget documents, cash plans, or audit queries, you are well positioned for the course. The course is set at foundation to intermediate level, so advanced treasury modelling or specialist accounting systems are not required before attendance.
